dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a sharp taper before the fluke insertion.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical bulges; the lower-left margin is partially obscured by surface water turbulence.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey skin tone consistent with a sub-adult or juvenile phase; significantly darker than mature white pigment.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-contrast, diffuse mottling across the dorsal plane with higher frequency of darker grey clusters near the head and left mid-body.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between light and medium grey pigmented regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced linear dorsal ridge extending from the mid-back toward the peduncle and a clearly visible blowhole aperture at the anterior extremity.
